==================
Property with Get and Set
==================

Class C
    Public Property Name() As String
        Get
            Return _name
        End Get
        Set(value As String)
            _name = value
        End Set
    End Property
End Class

==================
ReadOnly property
==================

Class C
    Public ReadOnly Property IsEmpty As Boolean
        Get
            Return Count = 0
        End Get
    End Property
End Class

==================
WriteOnly property
==================

Class C
    Public WriteOnly Property Password As String
        Set(value As String)
            _hash = Hash(value)
        End Set
    End Property
End Class

==================
Indexed property
==================

Class C
    Public Property Item(index As Integer) As String
        Get
            Return _items(index)
        End Get
        Set(value As String)
            _items(index) = value
        End Set
    End Property
End Class

==================
Default indexed property
==================

Class C
    Default Public Property Item(key As String) As Object
        Get
            Return _map(key)
        End Get
        Set(value As Object)
            _map(key) = value
        End Set
    End Property
End Class

==================
Property with blank line between Get and Set
==================

Class C
    Public Property Name() As String
        Get
            Return _name
        End Get

        Set(value As String)
            _name = value
        End Set
    End Property
End Class

==================
Property with attribute on Get accessor
==================

Class C
    Public ReadOnly Property Value As Integer
        <DebuggerHidden()>
        Get
            Return _value
        End Get
    End Property
End Class

==================
Property with attributes on both accessors
==================

Class C
    Public Property Data As String
        <DebuggerHidden()>
        Get
            Return _data
        End Get
        <DebuggerHidden()>
        Set(value As String)
            _data = value
        End Set
    End Property
End Class
